subject: Exec Convening: slot assignments + read-pack routing
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@acmecorp.com>, Benjamin Ortiz <ben@flightpath.co>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec Convening: slot assignments + read-pack routing

Team,

Thanks for jumping on this — we’ve got the Acme exec convening on Aug 18 in SF and need to lock the morning run-of-show, presenter slots, and the read-pack distribution plan by end of next week. High level asks:

- Finalize who owns each 15/20/30 min slot (exec intro, product vision, privacy/compliance, deployment roadmap, Q&A)
- Confirm which assets go into the external read-pack vs. an internal-only appendix (we should keep SOC2/attestations in a separate folder)
- Coordinate travel arrival times so we can sync a 30-min dry run the evening before for speakers and A/V check

Quick notes on constraints from Acme (Sarah): their SVP will only do a 20-minute slot at 10:40–11:00; procurement will join for the later roadmap/Q&A.

Can each of you reply with: 1) the slot(s) you’ll own, 2) whether you’ll present in-person or remote, and 3) any required assets (slide deck, demo VM, config snapshots) you need by Aug 4.

Irene — can you take lead on the read-pack folder structure and distribution timing? Rafael — can you confirm room AV and seating layout? Aditya — travel ops and presenter travel confirmations. I’ll consolidate and send the run-of-show draft on Monday.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127

Attachments: (referenced) none in this initial note
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec Convening: slot assignments + read-pack routing

On Thu, Jul 22, 2027 at 9:12 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team,
>
> Thanks for jumping on this — we’ve got the Acme exec convening on Aug 18 in SF and need to lock the morning run-of-show...

Thanks Hannah — happy to own the read-pack. Proposed folder layout (will create in Drive):

- "External_ReadPack/" (slides + 2-page summary + meeting agenda)
- "Internal_Appendix/" (SOC2 summary, redacted logs, customer-specific notes)
- "Bios/" (speaker one-pagers; public-facing only)

I attached a one-page template for the external summary and an initial presenter-bios workbook with the people I have so far. Please drop any missing bios into the sheet by Monday EOD.

I’ll also propose distribution timing: send the external read-pack to Acme 72 hours before the meeting (Aug 15, 09:00 PT) and the internal appendix to our CS/Eng stake-holders 24 hours before.

Irene
Irene Choi | Program Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
ireene.choi@redwood.ai

Attachments (2): presenter-bios_2027-07-23.xlsx (stub), external-summary-template.docx (stub)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@acmecorp.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec Convening: slot assignments + read-pack routing

Hannah / team —

I’ll own travel ops. Current plan and asks:

- Redwood team arrivals: recommend Aug 17 arrivals for speakers (afternoon) so we can do a 30-min dry run at 6:00pm in the venue greenroom. I’ll block hotels within a 10-min walk of the venue.
- Speaker logistics: I need names, cell numbers, and whether speakers require any demo credentials or on-prem access by Aug 2.
- Walk-in A/V items: two clickers, a single HDMI dongle + USB-C adapter, lapel mic per presenter. Rafael — can you confirm we have a spare spare HDMI cable and a local AV tech on call?

I’ve added a short travel worksheet to the Drive folder (link below). I’ll pull confirmations and send calendar invites by Aug 5.

- Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cacme-onboard-readpack

Aditya
Aditya Rao | Logistics & Events, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0144
From: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@acmecorp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Benjamin Ortiz <ben@flightpath.co>
Date: Mon, 25 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec Convening: slot assignments + read-pack routing

Hannah / team —

Appreciate the coordination. A couple of clarifications from Acme:

- Our SVP availability: confirmed 10:40–11:00 only. If you could slot the product vision at that time that would be ideal.
- On the read-pack: procurement has asked that any cost/pricing detail be delivered in a separate procurement appendix (we’ll share our PO templates the week of Aug 2).
- For onsite security: our policy requires visitor badges printed in advance and a list of devices that will access any of our demos. Please provide the device serials or VM IPs two days before the meeting.

Benjamin is copying in for the room and catering touchpoints — he’ll follow up directly with Rafael on the AV layout and meal slots.

Best,
Sarah Wells
Head of Strategy, Acme Corp
+1 212-555-0199
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@acmecorp.com>, Benjamin Ortiz <ben@flightpath.co>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec Convening: slot assignments + read-pack routing

Team — thanks for the fast turn. Consolidated plan (ACTION items bolded):

- Slot assignments (final):
  - 09:00–09:15 — Welcome & objectives — Hannah Schmitt (in-person)
  - 09:15–09:35 — Deployment roadmap — Rafael Mendes (in-person)
  - 09:35–09:55 — Privacy & compliance overview — Irene Choi (remote) — **Irene to prepare 2-page compliance appendix for internal appendix**
  - 10:00–10:20 — Customer case study (product depth) — Aditya Rao (in-person)
  - 10:40–11:00 — Product vision (SVP slot) — Rafael Mendes (in-person) — **Rafael to coordinate slides with Sarah's team**
  - 11:00–11:30 — Procurement & pricing Q&A — Hannah + Sarah (panel)

- Read-pack routing:
  - External read-pack (slides + 2-pager summary) to be shared with Acme Aug 15 09:00 PT — **Irene to publish folder and drop final PDFs by Aug 14 12:00 PT**
  - Procurement appendix (pricing, PO templates) will be delivered as a separate artifact, per Sarah — **Hannah to coordinate with sales ops on the doc**

- Logistics:
  - Dry run: Aug 17, 6:00pm venue greenroom — **Aditya to send calendar invites and hotel list by Aug 5**
  - Visitor badges & device list: **Aditya to collect device info; Sarah please confirm badge names by Aug 16**
  - AV checklist: Rafael to confirm spare HDMI and local tech by Aug 4. Rafael — I uploaded a rough seating diagram to Drive; please confirm any changes.

I attached the draft run-of-show and the presenter-bios workbook that Irene started. Please review and update your bios and any deck placeholders. We’ll do a final sync Wed Aug 11 10:00 PT (30-min) — calendar invite to follow.

If there are any blockers (travel approvals, visa notes, or procurement redlines) call me directly. Otherwise I’ll send the consolidated read-pack plan Monday morning.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127
